## Pull Request Description

### Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring / performance optimization
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, dependencies, or tooling
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `style`: UI styling or theme updates

### Area
- [ ] Frontend (`web/`)
- [ ] Backend (`cmd/`, `internal/`)
- [ ] Themes (`themes/`)
- [ ] Widgets (`widgets/`)
- [ ] Packaging / DevOps (`packaging/`, Docker, CI)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`)

### Summary of Changes
<!-- Provide a clear and concise description of what this PR introduces or fixes. -->

### Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards.
